events.headline: IRAN ATTACKS FIVE GULF NATIONS, SHUTS HORMUZ AFTER US BOMBING: ALL TO KNOW
events.detail: Tehran hits back at several GCC countries, following the most intense US bombing since an MoU was signed last month.

events.headline: MISSILES AND DRONES FIRED AT GULF STATES AFTER NIGHT OF US STRIKES ON IRAN
events.detail: Three people injured by falling shrapnel in Qatar as attacks also reported in UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Oman and Jordan.

events.headline: US LAUNCHES FRESH STRIKES AS IRAN CLOSES STRAIT OF HORMUZ
events.detail: The strikes follow an attack on a Cyprus -flagged vessel travelling through the critical waterway.

events.headline: US FORCES LAUNCH NEW STRIKES ON IRAN; TEHRAN CLOSES STRAIT OF HORMUZ
events.detail: US forces have launched a third round of strikes on Iran in a week.

events.headline: IRAN LAUNCHES ATTACKS ACROSS THE GULF AFTER MORE US STRIKES
events.detail: Iran says it launched missile attacks on US military sites in Bahrain, Kuwait, Jordan and Qatar.

events.headline: ESTADOS UNIDOS E IRÁN SE ENZARZAN EN UNA NUEVA ESPIRAL DE ATAQUES
events.detail: Las fuerzas estadounidenses han bombardeado Irán de nuevo después de que la Guardia Revolucionaria abriera fuego contra un carguero chipriota en el estrecho de Ormuz y declarase cerrada esa vía maríti
